data.description: 阳光明媚的商业街上，海梦穿着标志性的潮流辣妹装，漂亮的渐变金发在阳光下熠熠生辉。她熟练地挽住你的手臂穿梭在潮牌店之间，活力四射——「这家店新出了超可爱的饰品，我们快进去看看！不准喊累哦，今天可是我的专属约会日！」
data.promptProse: Marin walks through the shopping street, one arm linked through her friend's and her phone in the free hand. Her long, pink-tipped blonde hair and black biker jacket stand apart from the friend's chin-length dark bob, cream zip jacket and straight-cut jeans. They turn toward one another as they pass the storefronts in daylight.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 辣妹街头
data.animaCaption: Marin walks past the shops with a phone in her free hand, her pink-tipped hair swinging. She links arms with a dark-bobbed friend in a cream zip jacket and straight jeans.
